# Galactic Nurseries: Incubators of Faith
## Scripture
## "For you formed my inward parts; you knitted me together in my mother’s womb. I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made." - Psalm 139:13-14
## Reflection
As we gaze up at the night sky, we're drawn to the majestic star-forming regions, known as galactic nurseries. These vast, interstellar clouds give birth to new stars, planets, and potentially, new life. Similarly, our lives are incubators of faith, where God nurtures and guides us through various seasons of growth. Just as a mother's womb provides a safe and nourishing environment for a developing child, God's presence surrounds us, shaping and molding us into the people He intends us to be.
## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, we're amazed by the beauty and wonder of galactic nurseries, where new stars and planets are born. Help us to trust in Your gentle guidance, as You nurture and shape our lives, just as a mother cares for her child. May our hearts be incubators of faith, where Your love and presence grow, and may we emerge as fearfully and wonderfully made children of God, shining bright like the stars in the night sky.
